target.title: feat(android): add cron job management controls
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Android currently surfaces gateway cron jobs as status/detail information, but cron operators still need to switch back to another client to run, pause, edit, or remove scheduled work. This PR makes the Android settings cron surface actionable so mobile users can manage gateway cron jobs from the same place they inspect them.

## Summary

- Adds Android Settings cron-job management controls to inspect, run now, enable/disable, edit, and delete gateway cron jobs.
- Extends cron detail parsing to retain editable schedule, payload, session target, wake mode, and run-history metadata.
- Adds a dedicated Android cron screenshot/proof workflow and screenshot scene for the new management surface.

## Implementation notes

- Keeps the existing cron list/detail request guard and extends it with run history plus action state.
- Sends mutations through gateway RPCs: `cron.run`, `cron.update`, `cron.remove`, and `cron.runs`.
- Updates Android native i18n source entries and Android docs for the new screenshot scene.

## Evidence

Local lightweight checks only:

- `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD` ✅
- `bash -n scripts/android-screenshots.sh` ✅
- `tsx scripts/native-app-i18n.ts check` ✅

GitHub Actions proof on current PR head `c0c72efa83c10213c2cf9d519355485884554e16`:

- snowzlmbot Android Cron Management Proof: https://github.com/snowzlmbot/openclaw/actions/runs/29015743166 ✅ passed
- Job: `Build APK, prove cron RPCs, and capture screenshot` ✅ passed
- Upstream PR checks on the same head reported passing/skipped as applicable: dependency guard, security-sensitive guard, label/dispatch automation, and real-behavior proof.

Artifacts from the snowzlmbot proof run:

- `openclaw-android-cron-mutation-proof` (artifact id `8197569209`): JUnit XML + proof summary, `tests=2`, `failures=0`, `errors=0`.
- `openclaw-android-cron-management-screenshot` (artifact id `8197590985`): real Android emulator screenshot for the cron management settings surface.
- `openclaw-android-cron-management-apk` (artifact id `8197590765`): debug APK built by the proof workflow.

What the proof demonstrates:

1. The Android `NodeRuntime` connects to a gateway WebSocket and emits `cron.run`, `cron.update`, and `cron.remove` through the admin-scoped cron management controls.
2. The non-admin operator path blocks mutation RPCs when `operator.admin` is absent.
3. The Android proof workflow builds the APK in GitHub Actions and captures the cron management UI screenshot from an emulator.

Not run locally:

- Android Gradle build/test suites were not used as local evidence; the APK build, cron mutation proof, and screenshot capture were performed by GitHub Actions above.

## Risk and rollback

- Risk is limited to the Android settings cron-management surface and the added proof workflow.
- Rollback is straightforward: revert this PR to restore the prior read-only cron detail UI.
